Document-scanning firm Unsiloed Inc. today announced it has raised $7.5 million in seed funding to turn PDFs and other complex documents into structured, readable data for artificial intelligence agents. Participants in the round, led by Felicis, included Y Combinator, Orange Collective, Uncorrelated Ventures, Aarthi Ramamurthy and Beth Turner. A variety of documents arrive in formats […]
